responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 host C library bridge, wrapping common libc and POSIX calls such as read, write, close, malloc, realloc, getenv, file creation, seek, memory operations, process control, and formatted output. It also adapts Modula-2 string-style format parameters into C `printf`/`snprintf` varargs calls, making it the general-purpose libc compatibility layer for the boot runtime.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the Glibc pair: it defines the libc_* wrapper bodies and the format-string adaptation logic for printf/snprintf, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/Glibc.h is the interface header that exposes those wrappers, typedefs, and generated declarations to other runtime code.
